name: The Cards Never Lie
source:
The Cards Never Lie is a mystery predicated by lies and sustained by them. Solve the crime using your fake psychic powers and some old-fashioned snooping.

[From [url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-25/?action=preview&uid=14557]Ludum Dare[/url]]
translation:
《纸牌从不说谎》是一个以谎言为基础并由谎言维持的谜团。使用你的虚假心灵力量和一些老式的窥探来解决犯罪问题。

[来自[url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-25/?action=preview&uid=14557]Ludum Dare[/url]]
